All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Departure
Departure represents a single transport departure in the simulation.
Finder
Finder is a route-finding utility class that builds a graph of departures and searches for optimal routes according to given criteria (cheapest, fastest, minimum number of transfers).
Finder.Criteria
Optimization criteria for route selection.
Launcher
Launcher class is the entry point of the JavaFX application.
OptimalRouteData
OptimalRouteData represents information about an optimal route between two cities.
Route
Route represents a complete path between two cities in the transport system.
SceneManager
SceneManager is a utility class for switching between JavaFX scenes.
SimulationController
JavaFX controller for the simulation view.
Ticket
Ticket is a simple serializable data holder for storing information about a purchased route in the transport system.
TopFiveRoutesController
JavaFX controller for the "Top Five Routes" view.
TransportApp
TransportApp represents the main JavaFX application class for the Bus and Train transport system.
TransportController
TransportController is the JavaFX controller class responsible for handling user interactions in the main transport view and for managing ticket-related data.
TransportDataGenerator
TransportDataGenerator produces synthetic transport data for a grid of cities, including bus/train stations and random departures between neighboring cities.
TransportDataGenerator.Departure
A single departure (bus or train) from one city to a neighboring city.
TransportDataGenerator.Station
A station entry for a city: bus and train station identifiers.
TransportDataGenerator.TransportData
Container for all generated data: the country grid, stations, and departures.
